rule_version: LM(PC) Rules 2011, as amended up to 2012 (GSR 748(E) & GSR 734(E))

auto_rules.description: Name & address of manufacturer (and packer/importer if applicable) must be present on the label.
Month & year of manufacture/pre-packing/import must be declared.
Retail Sale Price (MRP) must be declared.
Consumer care details (phone or email for complaints) must be present.
MRP declaration should include 'inclusive of all taxes' phrasing.
Quantity declaration must not use misleading qualifiers.
Quantity must not be stated using words like dozen, score, gross, great gross.

manual_only_rules.description: Numeral height, width ratio, and colour-contrast checks require a physical reference scale — not reliably scannable from a phone photo alone. Requires manual/physical inspection.
Verifying actual fill quantity against declared quantity requires lab measurement, not a photo. Requires manual/physical inspection.
Tax-revision pricing compliance requires cross-checking manufacturer's published revision notices — not scannable from the label alone. Requires manual/officer review.
Penalty determination is an enforcement action taken by an officer after violations are confirmed, not an automated check.
